integrity: Two independent exact generators, full integer Walsh transform, 1024 directly checked quotient frequencies, Parseval, and projection-kernel reconstruction. No floating point.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite spectral classification only for the simple 3-by-3 toroidal square-ice graph; no higher-size classification or independently established publication priority.
title: Complete Walsh spectrum and optimal range projections for the smallest simple periodic square-ice torus
